issues.quote: Anna knew every single version, down to the tiniest detail.
Combined with a miniskirt, bronze high heels, and gold nails cast from melted Ethons, Agness's look defied
the Pen's discipline of high collars and habits clung to resident mages
Yet Agness could afford to dress flashy, like some Will-magess.
Because, exams aside, it was the curators who decided
guided a mage's path all the way to expulsion or graduation
A battle magess, a veteran, Agness lacked even a fifth-circle diploma—and rumor had it she hadn't even served her full ten years as a battle magess.
did nothing to remedy the situation

And Agness was doing both right now.
